images.filename: Marines Head For CH-46 Transport Helicopter, 1969 (29338495665).jpg
images.caption:
"All Aboard: Marines of the 1st Battalion, 4th Marines [1/4] head for a CH-46 transport helicopter at Vandegrift Combat Base to kick off another search and clear mission in the Scotland II area of operations south of the DMZ in Quang Tri Province of South Vietnam (official USMC photo by Sergeant Mike Padilla)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611) at the Archives Branch, Marine Corps History Division

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

images.filename: Marines From a Transport Helicopter, circa 1968 (29230408752).jpg
images.caption:
"Vertical Envelopment: Leathernecks of the 2d Battalion, 4th Marines [2/4] debark from a Marine Medium Helicopter Squadron 262 [HMM-262] Sea Knight transport helicopter near Lang Vei, as another Sea Knight lands with additionally Leathernecks (official USMC photo by Staff Sergeant R. B. Williams)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611) at the Archives Branch, Marine Corps History Division
